agent.bio: Priya has sold homes across the Denver metro area for fifteen years and founded Bluestem Realty Group to run every transaction the way she would want her own handled: a clear timeline, straight answers, and no surprises at closing. She specializes in first-time buyers and sellers moving out of state.
